tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun 'khrul zhig ka bzhi pa'i zhal snga nas la gsol 'debs bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ratna bha drā ya/ dkon mchog gsum dngos dngos grub rin chen gter/ /bzang po'i phrin las las bzhi lhun gyis grub/ /drin can bla ma ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon/ /snying nas rab gus gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod ni lha rigs jo bo'i brgyud 'khrungs nas/ /nags rgyal ri bo'i sman ljongs nyams dga' bar/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan drung du rab byung nas/ /phyi don sgro 'dogs rgya chen bcad la 'dud/ /chos kyi rgyal po nam mkha'i mtshan can la/ /sham bha la yi zab don bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /legs par blangs nas rtse gcig bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /nges pa'i don gyi gnas lugs gzigs la 'dud/ /rig 'dzin sangs rgyas bstan pa'i zhal gyi rgyun/ /theg pa dgu las 'das pa'i blo bral chos/ /dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs kyi yang snying mchog /kun bzang dgongs pa mngon du gyur la 'dud/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rnam rgyal bzang po las/ /padma'i thugs bcud yang gsang khros pa gsan/ /bsgrubs pas drag sngags nus pa mngon du gyur/ /bka' srung dam can bran du 'khol la 'dud/ /bal yul grong khyer chen po'i yul ljongs su/ /he ru ka dpal gtsang smyon chos rje las/ /dam chos zab mo phyag chen legs par thob/ /snang srid chos skur shar ba de la 'dud/ /'khrul snang las nyon sprin rum dbyings su dengs/ /'od gsal bde chen nyin byed thugs la shar/ /lha dang srung ma'i zhal bzang mngon sum gzigs/ /mthu stobs mthar son grub dbang chen por 'dud/ /khyab bdag gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /gangs can gdul bya'i skyabs mchog thod 'phreng rtsal/ /yongs su grags pa'i drin can ka bzhi pa/ /rnam gsum dbyer med zhabs la snying nas 'dud/ /de ltar rje btsun bla ma dam pa la/ /snying nas gus pa'i gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag dang nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/

/mchog gi bla ma dam pas rjes bzung nas/ /rab 'byams las bzhi thogs med 'grub pa dang / /tha mal 'khrul pa'i snang ba dbyings su thim/ /rang rig rang ngo shes pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /kun bzang dgongs pa tshe 'dir 'grub par shog /ces rje btsun bla ma dam pa lcags thang ka bzhi pa chen po 'khrul zhig ratna bha dra'i zhabs la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni/ rje nyid kyi dbon sras chos kyi rje stobs ldan 'od zer ba'i gsung gis bskul zhing / rang nyid kyang dad pas kun nas bslangs te/ bande blo gsal rgya mtshos nye bar sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje btsun 'khrul zhig ka bzhi pa'i zhal snga nas la gsol 'debs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
